# Performing Edge Coach

> Dr. JoAnn Dahlkoetter's sports psychology certification program training coaches to enhance athletic performance through mental training and peak performance coaching.

Performing Edge Coach offers professional certification in sports psychology and performance coaching, serving athletes and coaches seeking to develop mental skills and coaching expertise. The program is based in San Carlos, California and includes a network of certified coaching professionals.

## Key Topics

- Sports Psychology
- Coach Certification
- Performance Coaching
- Peak Performance
- Athlete Coaching
- Mindset Training
- Dr. JoAnn Dahlkoetter
- PECI (Performing Edge Coaching International)
- Certified Performing Edge Coach
- Sports Psychology Certification
- Coach Training
- Career Opportunities
- Ironman Triathlon
- Coaching Training
- Sports Psychology Business
